If one of the days on which there was no flight delay is selected at random, what is the probability the day was a weekend day?
explanation: Choice B is correct. There were $90$ days with no flight delay. Of those $90$ days, $18$ were weekend days. Because the day is selected at random, each day has an equal chance of being selected, so the probability is $\frac{18}{90} = \frac{1}{5}$.
